---
title: Model fitting
---

When developing mathematical models you will inherently end up with parameters.
These parameters may be known *a-priori*, for example Planck's constant or the speed of light, but others may need to be estimated from observed data.
In fact, you may have written down your model with the express intention of determining these parameters through experiment.
In this section, we will work through techniques that can be used to fit models to data.
